lifecycle.standingAuthority: create a clean successor and archive the predecessor after acknowledgment
onRotationGuard: finish or pause at the next safe boundary
write a compact handback and update the work ledger
create a clean task in this project without inheriting the predecessor transcript
obtain the successor acknowledgment before archiving the predecessor
never: abandon unfinished work because a guard was reached
fork or copy the predecessor transcript
archive the predecessor before successor acknowledgment

public-experience.purpose: Public product, share, consultation, contribution, concern, ingredient, and retailer interface work
verification: Perform desktop and mobile browser QA
exclusions: Catalogue evidence and release records unless the route requires a specific product fixture
Full release verification for a local visual adjustment

customer-experience.purpose: Private JeloCare Me routes, customer-owned Shelf, Routine, product requests, account helpers, and owner-isolated read and mutation boundaries
verification: Run the selected private-domain security and capability tests
Run signed-out and authenticated route smoke when the change affects customer interaction
Require owner-isolation evidence for every persistence change
exclusions: Granting customer or Ops authority over catalogue evidence
Exposing owner identifiers or private payloads in URLs, logs, analytics, screenshots, or handbacks

ops-experience.purpose: Operations shell, route grammar, queues, contextual inspectors, responsive states, and operator interaction
verification: Run the selected Ops route's focused tests
Perform desktop three-column and compact overlay browser QA
exclusions: Changing moderation semantics or database schema

catalogue-evidence.purpose: Exact product identity, care evidence, Nigerian offers, asset provenance, dossiers, and publication releases

batchPolicy.unit: one exact SKU per release cell
preflight: Confirm exact brand, variant, size, package form, and manufacturer identifier before downstream work
Confirm source, media, upload, release, and rollback access before deep work
release: Run focused checks per cell and one broad integration gate per release wave
Never let an unresolved sibling or optional framework expansion hold an admitted SKU

identity-evidence.outcome: Bind one exact manufacturer SKU, size, package form, source digest, and public eligibility basis
identity-evidence.mustNot: Infer one size, bottle, refill, or reformulation from another

media.outcome: Bind a provenance-documented immutable packshot to the exact SKU and pass artifact/crop/padding QA
media.mustNot: Reuse another size's image or publish generated packaging details

offers.outcome: Admit only fresh exact Nigerian listings with supported price, stock, store identity, size, and package evidence
offers.mustNot: Widen or omit size/variant tokens, or project expired and zero-stock observations

care-content.outcome: Publish neutral, non-diagnostic care context and exact manufacturer directions
care-content.mustNot: Turn a product listing into personalized diagnosis or unsupported efficacy claims

integration.outcome: Record the release matrix, run the broad gate once, commit scoped cells, push, confirm the exact deployment, smoke routes, and prepare client links
integration.mustNot: Commit dirty unrelated paths or hold passing cells for blocked siblings

verification: Run deterministic candidate, dossier, release, and image gates for the selected SKU
Run broad release verification once at batch integration

data-administration.purpose: Community intake, observations, vocabulary, relationships, retailers, operators, moderation, and database CRUD
verification: Run focused domain tests and read-only reconciliation
Require an explicit migration boundary for schema changes
exclusions: Visual redesign beyond the data contract
Production mutation outside the requested admin scope

platform-delivery.purpose: Authentication, infrastructure, migrations, scheduled work, CI, deployment, and observability
verification: Run focused security or delivery checks
Run build and production smoke only at the integration boundary

growth-campaigns.purpose: Evidence-bound campaign selection, creative production, attribution, and publication handoff
verification: Verify exact SKU, current offer, share route, care boundary, and asset provenance
Require explicit confirmation before external publishing or spend
exclusions: Using paid-source metadata to change skincare guidance or store order
Treating prior creative prices as current evidence
Touching user-owned campaign assets outside the selected campaign
